plain: A person chosen to speak and vote for others at a meeting

webster.text: To send away; appropriately, to send on an embassy; to send with power to transact business, as a representative.

more.text: A person appointed and sent by another with powers to transact business as his representative; a deputy; a commissioner; a vicar.

example.quote: As soon as a legislature shall be formed in the district, the council and house assembled in one room, shall have authority, by joint ballot, to elect a delegate to Congress, who shall have a seat in Congress, with a right of debating but not voting during this temporary government.
